metadata.description: Claude Code plugin to search free CC0 3D game assets (models, PBR materials, decals, MatCaps, skyboxes) from your AI and save them straight into your project

plugins.name: game-3d-assets
plugins.description: Ask for 'a street lamp 3D model' or 'a wood PBR texture' and it searches Free Game 3D Assets and saves the GLB/FBX/PNG. Bundles a skill that drives the freegame3d CLI (npx, no setup). All assets are CC0 (commercial use OK, no attribution).
